sections.text: Azure God of the Axe XL

[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Soldier/Berserker:
Physical and magic Ability Power increases by XL - 5XL based on the water elemental attack value.

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.
Only activates when playing as Soldier/Berserker.

[Activation Rate]
M+
Activation rate against Fire enemies increases to L+.
